statements.__comment: Attribute nodes are per snapshot (id '<snapshot arn>/<name>'); one no longer returned for its snapshot is stale. Runs before the snapshot statements so a deleted snapshot's attributes go too.
statements.query: MATCH (n:RDSSnapshotAttribute)<-[:HAS_ATTRIBUTE]-(:RDSSnapshot)<-[:RESOURCE]-(:AWSAccount{id: $AWS_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:AWSOrganization{id: $ORGANIZATION_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID}) WHERE n.lastupdated <> $UPDATE_TAG WITH n LIMIT $LIMIT_SIZE DETACH DELETE (n) return COUNT(*) as TotalCompleted

statements.__comment: Legacy attribute nodes merged by name alone (no id) were shared by every snapshot of every tenant; nothing reads them.
statements.query: MATCH (n:RDSSnapshotAttribute) WHERE n.id IS NULL WITH n LIMIT $LIMIT_SIZE DETACH DELETE (n) return COUNT(*) as TotalCompleted
